text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
……A loss is a loss. I have no intention of 
making excuses.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, let's head back and analyze the 
race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Those winners had such magnificent runs. 
There's surely plenty we can learn from 
them!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I also have to review my own 
run from when I lost.
choice_data_list: Let's review the basics more closely.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I also have to review my own 
run from when I lost.
choice_data_list: Let's review the basics more closely.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but my current analytical abilities 
weren't enough to win. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let's update ourselves together, you and 
I. ...So that we can seize the next 
victory together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So that's your analysis after seeing how I 
ran today, is it...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's start with basic training. 
As they say, an onlooker sees most of the 
game, and above all—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Coming from you, that alone makes it well 
worth a shot!"
